newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Injury count in Hebron shooting revised to seven.
newsitem.headline: Injury count in Hebron shooting revised to seven.

text.p: Seven Palestinians were wounded when an Israeli soldier opened fire in Hebron on Wednesday, said Yousef Sharawi, director of the West Bank town's Alia hospital.

Palestinian officials had said eight were wounded. But Sharawi told Reuters: "The vegetable market shooting resulted in the injury of seven from gunshots and another five from Israeli military beatings.
"There are only two cases in critical condition. They went through surgery, and their condition is now stable," he said.
